In Christian symbolism, “Israel” therefore commonly represents the people of God, although Christians disagree sharply over whether this designation refers primarily to ethnic Israel, the church, or both in different senses.","primary_basis":["Genesis 32:28 — Jacob receives the name Israel, from whom the people derive their name.","Exodus 4:22 — Israel is called God’s firstborn son.","Exodus 19:5–6 — Israel is designated God’s treasured possession, a kingdom of priests, and a holy nation.","Deuteronomy 7:6–8 — Israel is described as a people chosen and loved by God.","Isaiah 41:8–10;
